_comment: MEC 030 publish_v2x_message body for the hosted ETSI MEC Sandbox (AdvantEDGE V2X Information Service, API v3.2.2). Root attributes: msgContent, msgRepresentationFormat, msgPropertiesValues. warning_ae.py overwrites msgContent (hex of the warning summary) and msgPropertiesValues.locationInfo.geoArea (the node position). IMPORTANT (confirmed 2026-11-14 from the Sandbox source go-packages/meep-vis-traffic-mgr/mqtt.go): the broker's Send accepts ONLY msgRepresentationFormat == 'hexadump' and hex-decodes msgContent; any other value (e.g. 'base64') is answered HTTP 500 'MQTT encoding not supported'. So msgContent MUST be a hex string and msgRepresentationFormat MUST be 'hexadump'. The publish path does not parse ecgi/msgType/content, so those values are not validated. If a Sandbox update changes the schema, paste the Swagger 'Example Value' here and keep the structure.
